newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CST.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to up 0.300 cent. Strong cash beef and feedlots seen holding asking prices firm.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to up 0.300 cent. Feeder index up and corn futures expected lower.
LEAN HOGS - Up 0.500 to 1.250 cent. Carryover from limit gains last week on Taiwan pork export ban. Cash markets up.
PORK BELLIES - Up 0.500 to 2.000 cent. Carryover from sharp gains on Taiwan. Cold Storage report bearish for pork but will be offset by Taiwan.
